answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a public work history: each agent locks a deposit before trading, and the deposit is slashed if peers prove it runs duplicate identities, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits. Trust then accrues slowly, like water carving karst, widening a channel no newcomer can fake overnight. A gale of fresh accounts may still arrive, but without deposits and history they cannot outbid established agents, and a sable-dark audit trail of signed attestations makes each fake easy to spot and cut off.
